name: How do I choose the right contractor for older-home modernization?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for older-home modernization?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor for older-home modernization requires careful consideration of their experience, portfolio, and communication style. Look for a company with a proven track record in renovating period homes and a deep understanding of the unique challenges involved. Review their previous projects to ensure their aesthetic aligns with your vision. It's crucial to select a contractor who is transparent about costs, timelines, and potential issues, and who provides clear contracts. Opus Builders specializes in luxury older-home renovations and provides comprehensive client support.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with proven experience in older home renovations, a portfolio aligning with your vision, and transparent communication. Ensure they understand unique challenges and provide clear contracts.
